text: {"danger_level":"green","danger_reason":"You are on relatively higher ground based on the susceptibility heuristic for 150.0 mm of rainfall in 24 hours.","main_move":"STAY_ALERT","main_move_text":"Stay alert and follow official updates","where_to_go":"Stay where you are and remain alert as no evacuation target is assigned.","do_now":[{"text":"Keep your mobile phones charged.","advice_ids":["fl.phone"]},{"text":"Listen to radio or watch television for the latest weather bulletins and flood warnings.","advice_ids":["fl.updates"]},{"text":"Stay in touch with local officials and follow instructions if asked to evacuate.","advice_ids":["fl.follow_officials"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not spread rumours and rely only on authentic official updates from radio or TV.","advice_ids":["fl.rumours"]},{"text":"Do not walk in moving water, drive through water, go down to lower floors, or enter underpasses.","advice_ids":[]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"In any situation","text":"Keep mobile phones charged and follow official weather updates.","advice_ids":["fl.phone","fl.updates"]}],"call":["112 - National emergency number","108 - Ambulance","101 - Fire and rescue"],"confidence":"medium","confidence_reason":"Confidence is medium because flood tiers are based on land height and rainfall susceptibility heuristics rather than official forecast models, and hospital emergency status is unverified.","unknowns":["Hospitals shown are mapped major hospitals; their emergency services, capacity and current status are not verified.","Flood tiers are a susceptibility estimate from land height, nearby water and rainfall; they are not a flood forecast.","Elevation is a 30 m surface model with several metres of vertical error; street flooding from overwhelmed drains is not captured."],"valid_while":[]}
